newsitem.title: USA: GenRad Inc completes sale of HQ building.
newsitem.headline: GenRad Inc completes sale of HQ building.

text.p: GenRad Inc said on Thursday it completed the sale of its 400,000-square-foot headquarters in Concord to Hall Gillespie Inc for $6 million in net cash.
GenRad, which has occupied the building for almost 40 years, will move in the spring to leased property in the Westford Technology Park in Westford, Mass.
GenRad recorded a $3.8 million gain in the fourth quarter of 1996 in connection with the sale.
Hall Gillespie is a joint venture between Hall Properties Inc and Gillespie Co Inc.
GenRad is a technology firm that provides hardware and software to help firms maximize productivity.
